culture.label: Interface language & region
culture.hint: Controls JobLens chrome and the language Claude uses for triage responses. Search by language, country, or code. Auto follows your browser languages and falls back to US English.

preflight.modeHint: Speedy skip signals before a full Scan. Uses Haiku (no extended thinking) regardless of the Scan model above. Auto checks listings as you open them; Hybrid waits for Quick check to spend Haiku tokens.

launcher.contextInvalidated: JobLens was updated or reloaded — refresh this page to continue.
launcher.openPosting: Open a job posting page on this site (not a search/list page).

options.apiKeyNote: Stored only in this browser profile. Sent directly to the Anthropic API.
options.identityNote: No name or identity fields are required for triage. Add only what changes matching.
options.workAuthPlaceholder: e.g. US citizen, no sponsorship needed
options.unsaved: Unsaved changes — save before closing this tab.
options.apiKeyNoteLong: Stored only in this browser profile and sent directly to the Anthropic API. Anyone with access to the profile can read it — use a dedicated key with limits.
options.modelStale: Previous model {{model}} is not in the current list; Sonnet 5 is selected. Save to persist.
options.geoHint: Required for Scan — set at least one of: a commute ZIP, remote-eligible regions, or Remote only. Without geography intent, scanning is blocked.
options.remoteOnly: Remote only — skip onsite and hybrid roles
options.importHint: Upload resumes or notes (.txt, .md, .pdf, .docx). JobLens proposes config changes; you review and apply into the draft, then Save.
options.educationCustom: Custom value on file: {{value}}. Choose a list item to replace it.
options.geoRemoteOnlyHint: ZIP radii are optional while Remote only is on (useful if you later uncheck). Regions still help with residency-restricted remote postings.
options.geoZipHint: Add each ZIP you'd commute to for onsite/hybrid checks.
options.travelHint: When set, primarily remote / light-hybrid roles that ask for onsite visits up to this often (and no more) get a Soft concern instead of a Hard skip if the site is outside your ZIP radii. None keeps the strict commute hard-skip. Daily or multi-day office weeks still hard-skip.
options.regionsLabel: Where you can work from for remote roles (comma-separated US states, e.g. CA, NY)
options.regionsHint: Residency filter for remote jobs only — not commute cities. Nationwide remote with no residency limit stays eligible even when the employer lists an out-of-region HQ.
options.relocationFlag: Flag relocation required outside my metros without subsidy language
options.skillsHint: Strongly recommended for reliable Fit/Apply. One list: Held = ground truth for matches; Ramp = partial; Never-claim = mismatch if required. Extract from history merges new skills in as held — review standings before Save.
options.gapsLabel: Known gaps (one per line — quick list; prefer standing above when possible)
options.jobDescPlaceholder: What you did — activities, technologies, scope
options.employmentPriorityHint: Employment priority (check to include; use arrows to rank).
options.blockedEmployersPlaceholder: Company or entity names to hard-skip
options.payFloorsHint: Min/max only apply when “Skip jobs outside my min–max” is selected.
options.flagSuspiciousComp: Flag suspiciously high or low pay vs typical market (rationale only)
options.preferStructured: Prefer structured / high-accountability JD language (soft Fit weight)
options.pipelineLoad: How full is your application pipeline?
options.pipelineHint: Adds a short note to Apply guidance only; does not reject roles.
options.roleSkipHint: Role-type skips (all off by default — enable only what you want).
options.skipMl: Jobs whose main purpose is training ML / AI / LLMs
options.skipMlHint: Flags postings where the work is building/training models (not a normal product or ops role that merely uses AI).
options.skipAiInterviewHint: Flag or skip postings that advertise live AI-proctored technical interviews.
options.skipUnverifiableHint: Flag employers with no clear web presence or identity.
options.clearancePreferred: Also treat “preferred / able to obtain” clearance as in-scope for the policy
options.statusChooseFiles: Choose one or more .txt, .md, .pdf, or .docx files first.
options.statusTruncatedPropose: Text truncated to limit; proposing config changes…
options.statusProposed: Proposed {{count}} change(s). Review and apply, then Save.
options.statusNoProposed: No changes proposed from those documents.
options.statusSelectChange: Select at least one change to apply.
options.statusApplied: Applied {{count}} change(s). Review drafts, then Save.
options.statusMergedSkills: Merged {{added}} new skill(s) from history ({{found}} found). Review standings below, then Save.

triage.title: JobLens
triage.idleHint: Open a supported job posting, then Scan.

sidepanel.noApiKey: Add an Anthropic API key in Options before scanning.
sidepanel.geoRequired: Set geography intent in Options (ZIP, region, or remote-only) before scanning.
sidepanel.unsupported: This page is not a supported job posting.
